summary: The 2D font and layout stack was simplified and hardened: feature-pref flags for COLR v1 (color fonts), font-variations, and font-palette were removed as these features are now stable, and a new Sans Serif Collection was added for Windows. There are also stronger validations in shaping (Graphite shaper), safer memory initialization, and glyph-handling fixes. Users should see more reliable font rendering and fewer layout or shaping errors across diverse fonts.
